declarations.description:
The Clinical Notes client.

Clinical Notes capture can be started by the session host. Participants can ask
the host to stop capture, and the host can approve or decline that request.

methods.name: startCapture
methods.description: Start Clinical Notes capture as the host.

methods.name: pauseCapture
methods.description: Pause an in-progress Clinical Notes capture.

methods.name: resumeCapture
methods.description: Resume a paused Clinical Notes capture.

methods.name: askToStopCapture
methods.description:
Ask the host to stop Clinical Notes capture.

Only a participant (non-host) can call this method.
Listen to `clinical-notes-stop-response` for the host decision.

methods.name: approveStopCapture
methods.description:
Approve a participant's request to stop Clinical Notes capture.

Only the host can call this method.

methods.name: declineStopCapture
methods.description:
Decline a participant's request to stop Clinical Notes capture.

Only the host can call this method.

methods.name: isClinicalNotesEnabled
methods.description: Get whether Clinical Notes is enabled for this session.

methods.name: getClinicalNotesStatus

returns.description: Current capture status and stream ID.
